svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION

g.text: Open-air storeys: at least 25% of the
perimeter wall area open, with cross-
No other occupancy in the building:
ARTICLE 3.2.2.92. GROUP F, DIVISION 3, STORAGE GARAGES UP TO 22 M HIGH
A storage garage with all storeys constructed as open-air storeys and no other occupancy above it
may have its floor, wall, ceiling and roof assemblies built without a fire-resistance rating, provided it is
not more than 22 m (72′-2⅛″) high, measured between grade and the ceiling level of the top storey,
not more than 10 000 m² (107 639 ft²) in building area, and
designed so that every portion of each floor area is within 60 m (196′-10¼″) of an exterior wall opening.

of its perimeter walls is open to the outdoors in
a manner that will provide cross-ventilation to
Drawn: a two-level open parking garage, deck cut away at the front to show the lower storey. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.18.8. (page 9-97), with Article 3.2.2.92. and Division A, Article 1.4.1.2.
